vibe: Premium, Trustworthy, Human, Modern & Clean Medical

headings.usage_rules: Do NOT use Inter or Roboto for headings. Use Outfit for a clean, modern, approachable yet professional feel. Employ font-light (300) for large elegant hero text, and font-semibold for card titles.

body.usage_rules: Clean, legible geometric sans for all body copy.

colors.rules: Avoid neon teal (#1B93A4) and purple/blue gradients. Stick to soft, grounded earthy teals/blues paired with a warm terracotta accent for human touch. Backgrounds should be off-white/pearl to feel clinical but warm.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing (p-8, p-12, py-24). Allow the page to breathe.

grid_system.marketing_hero: grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 with asymmetric spans (e.g., text col-span-5, image col-span-7).
grid_system.services_bento: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6. Use overlapping elements and avoid perfect symmetry.

spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-align dense text and headings for better readability. Use optical alignment for buttons.
spacing_and_layout.container_radius: rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl for large images/cards to soften the 'medical' harshness.

surface_strategies.header: Crystal Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl, bg-white/80, 1px border-b border-white/20, shadow-sm). Sticky top-0 z-50.
surface_strategies.cards: Flat white background (bg-white) with a very subtle 1px border (border-[#E2E8E8]) and soft shadow on hover (hover:shadow-xl).
surface_strategies.buttons: Primary: Solid #2C5E5E with white text, rounded-full or rounded-xl. Accent/Emergency: Solid #E87A5D. Hover: Slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow.

patterns.hero_load: Fade up with y: 20, stagger children by 0.1s.
patterns.image_parallax: Subtle scale-up (scale: 1.05) on hover for service cards and blog images.
patterns.micro_interactions: Hover states on all buttons and links.

components_to_build.Hero: Asymmetric layout. Large emotional text 'Compassionate Care, Advanced Medicine'. Soft overlay over a premium hospital architecture image.
components_to_build.About: Overlapping images (doctor + patient care) with a storytelling text block.
components_to_build.Services: Bento grid of departments (Cardiology, Neurology, etc.). Use @phosphor-icons/react or lucide-react (Duotone).
components_to_build.Doctors: Carousel or grid of specialists. Focus on friendly, caring portraits.
components_to_build.Testimonials: Editorial layout. Large quote marks, clean typography.
components_to_build.Blog: Cards with large imagery (nature/healthy lifestyle) and dates.
components_to_build.Contact: Grid with address, emergency CTA, phone, and hours.

icons.style: Use stroke-width 1.5 for a clean, premium look.

media.rules: Never use placeholder images. Use gradient overlays (e.g. from-black/50 to-transparent) ONLY if text sits directly on images to pass contrast rules.

testing.attributes: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs) using kebab-case role-based names (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Install lenis for smooth scrolling and framer-motion for animations.
Configure tailwind.config.js with the specified colors and fonts (Outfit, Plus Jakarta Sans).
Build a fully responsive marketing site starting with a fixed glassmorphism header.
Implement an asymmetric Hero section with the provided architecture image.
Build out About, Services, Doctors, Testimonials, Blog, and Contact sections using the provided image URLs.
Ensure generous spacing (e.g., py-24 for sections) and adhere strictly to the Archetype 1 Light Theme.
Avoid typical Vercel/Stripe card looks; use soft borders, rounded-2xl radii, and earthy/teal accents to create a premium, human medical aesthetic.
